answer.answer: Sunlight: Both basil and zucchini need full sun. Water needs: Basil has moderate water needs; zucchini is not recorded. Growth period: Not recorded for either. Soil pH: Both have a minimum pH of 6.0 and maximum of 7.0. Maintenance: Basil requires pinching tips and weekly inspection; zucchini has no specific maintenance noted. Care: Basil is a light feeder; zucchini is not recorded.

Plant Almanac plant: Basil - Genovese.
Scientific name: Ocimum basilicum.
Summary: Sweet basil with aromatic leaves for the kitchen and flowers for visiting insects..
Water needs: moderate.
Sun needs: full sun.
Care: Pinch growing tips to encourage branching and harvest before cold weather..
Sowing notes: Sep–Feb.
Minimum soil pH: 6.0.
Maximum soil pH: 7.0.
In-row spacing (cm): 25.0.
Row spacing (cm): 30.0.
Succession interval (days): 28.
Harvest window (weeks): 8.0.
Yield per plant: 0.2.
Yield unit: kg.
Yield notes: 0.2 kg per established plant over a 8-week harvest window. Total across repeated pickings, not the yield at every picking..
Feeder type: light feeder.
Forest layer: herbaceous.
Part used: leaf.
Uses: culinary.
Uses notes: Culinary herb for the herbaceous layer; allow a few stems to flower for visiting insects.
Fresh leaves for pesto, pasta, salads and sauces..
Management notes: Inspect weekly, remove affected plant material, use clean tools and encourage beneficial insects. Confirm the pest or disease before choosing treatment..
Associated pests: Aphids, Slugs and snails.
Rotation group: Anywhere; feeder weight: light; rotation exempt: True.
Recorded companion: Alyssum; function: pollinator attractor; notes: A low flowering edge provides nectar for visiting insects. Keep it outside the crop's spacing so it does not crowd young plants..
Recorded companion: Marigold - French Marigold; function: pollinator attractor; notes: Add a sunny flowering border for insect habitat. Leave enough space between the flowers and the crop for light and airflow..
